scope: bounded mechanism check; simplified same-range array IQ, not full FMCW/radar or real-data validation
question: When two same-range scatterers have common structural motion, does array-only split help when angles are separable, and is an unresolved mixture always a geometrically equivalent target?

physical_model.snapshot: z[k,m] = sum_i a_i exp(j(psi_i + 4*pi*q[k]*cos(theta_i)/lambda)) exp(j*pi*m*sin(theta_i)) + complex Gaussian noise
physical_model.common_motion: q[k] = A1 sin(2*pi*3*t + p) + A2 sin(2*pi*5*t + p2); one q shared by all scatterers
physical_model.noise: complex Gaussian; sigma set from declared source amplitudes and SNR (not post-interference cancellation)

estimator.inputs: array IQ only plus declared lambda/array/noise constants; no true angles, amplitudes, phases, or q
estimator.angle_estimation: time-averaged covariance Bartlett spectrum on -60..60 deg in 0.25 deg grid
estimator.peak_rule: local peaks, >=12 deg apart, second peak >=0.18 of strongest, retain at most 2
estimator.split_route: beamform each of strongest two detected peaks; unwrap phase relative to first sample; qhat = lambda*phase/(4*pi*cos(theta_hat)); fixed initial-magnitude-squared fusion
estimator.merge_route: beamform at strongest detected peak; same phase/geometry conversion
estimator.guard: reject a channel if minimum magnitude < 5x declared complex-noise sigma

baselines.merge: single equivalent target phasor from the same range cell
baselines.split: two range-angle phasors when two array-only peaks pass the rule
baselines.fair_scoring: same q-q[0] reference and same positive phase sign; no per-route sign/refit optimization

evaluation.coverage: finite estimate plus beamformed magnitude guard; abstentions are reported, not discarded
evaluation.truth_role: q is used only after estimation for evaluator waveform error and never passed into estimator
